pairs: The Praise of a Canticle, of David himself.
In the time before the Sabbath,
He has been clothed with beauty.
The Lord has been clothed with strength,
Yet he has also confirmed the world,
My throne is prepared from of old.
the floods have lifted up their voice.
The floods have lifted up their waves,
before the noise of many waters.
Wondrous are the surges of the sea;
wondrous is the Lord on high.
Testimonia tua credibilia facta sunt nimis;
Your testimonies have been made exceedingly trustworthy.
